notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Dear Gamers!

The Update 1.01 is come.
Now we support Linux and Mac OS.
And my wonderful friend helped translate the game into an additional language: Russian.

Now you can buy Space Roguelike Adventure as part of a great bundle RUN AND JUMP BUNDLE with two other colorful platformer games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30364/RUN_AND_JUMP_BUNDLE/

In the game we also have an alternate ending where you refuse to continue killing monsters. You need to stand near the main white regent in the hub at any time after completing the tutorial level and hold the use button a 3-5 seconds. After that you will see the ending cutscene and recieve all achivements, but...no spoilers more.

We hope these improvement will allow you to save the universe better, faster, higher and enjoy the game more. And don't forget to write us your reviews.
Have a nice game ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Space Roguelike Adventure on Steam Next Fest: October Edition
notes.content:
[b]Space Roguelike Adventure[/b] is taking a part on [b]Steam Next Fest: October Edition. [/b]
You can watch my let's play or play your self on game ready [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1775860/Space_Roguelike_Adventure/]demo[/url].


[b]About the game:[/b]
Now, there’s another far far galaxy from a parallel universe — and suddenly the Rainbow planet appeared there for no particular reason. It had such a strong magnetic field that it practically smashed the protective barrier of the prison planet Abakaz. Many dangerous galactic criminals have managed to escape and settled in some uninhabited lands. All these unfortunate events bring us to the point where the adventures of a young hunter from planet Earth will start. It’s you, of course!

[b]Space Roguelike Adventure is [/b]
- Five unique planets
- Unicorn’s head acting all bossy (gonna neigh you to death)
- Energy swords
- Funny space armor that looks so familiar
- Procedurally generated levels
- Two possible endings
And much more (we just have a limit of six key features).

So there you go, going to have a great time with our newest game: Space Roguelike Adventure! And yeah, we’ve picked this title because it’s a perfect summary of this literary-rich marketing post.
